d: U.S. President Donald Trump has welcomed Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia’s leadership, saying markets have reacted positively to the move. Speaking to reporters on Thursday, November 26, Trump praised Huang as a crucial figure for Nvidia and expressed confidence in the company's future. Trump also revealed that he was concerned after the Nasdaq plunged more than 4% during Wednesday’s trading session, before recovering most of its losses by the market close. He described Huang’s return as a positive development for the United States and the global technology industry.
